subject: Banking
title: The Inflation Mistake of 2021
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Inflation Mistake of 2021.

hook.text: In 2021, the Fed called inflation 'transitory' and kept rates at zero. It lasted 18 months and peaked at 9.1%.

buildup.text: Pandemic stimulus checks, supply chain disruptions, and low rates fueled spending.

discovery.text: The Fed delayed rate hikes by months, believing inflation would fade. By the time they acted, it had become entrenched.

twist.text: The delay forced the fastest rate hikes in 40 years. A gradual adjustment became an emergency response.

climax.text: Calling inflation transitory was the Fed's biggest recent mistake.

punchline.text: Called it transitory. Waited too long. Then raised rates at record speed.

quiz.question: What did the Fed call inflation in 2021?
